name: projectFR - Antidromic stimulation of MN and RC
description: Antidromic stimulation of motoneurons and Renshaw cells: 20 mA pulses on the posterior tibial nerve, at 60 Hz from 100 to 300 ms, with 60 Hz added to the frequency from 200 to 300 ms, on 5 S motoneurons of the soleus connected to 2 Renshaw cells, with 100% connectivity both ways and the synapse of the motoneurons on the Renshaw cells with depression. The antidromic spikes activate the Renshaw cells, which inhibit the motoneurons. No descending command and no afferents; the Renshaw cells have the spontaneous firing of 7 Hz. Converted from the AntidromicSimulationofMNandRC example of projectFR, the Fortran version of ReMoto (R. N. Watanabe, github.com/rnwatanabe/projectFR): the design of the experiment is that of the example, and the model parameters are those of ReMoto in Java, on top of configuration 24 of the original database.
